Chief Selector Agarkar Skips BCCI Review Meeting Amid Uncertainty

Ajit Agarkar, the chief selector for the Indian men's cricket team, missed a review meeting convened by the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI). The meeting was scheduled to discuss the team's recent performance, including losses during tours of Ireland and England. Agarkar's absence has fueled speculation and uncertainty regarding his future in the role.
